comment: The wallpaper looks, in u_look order, and the files every shader is assembled from: the entry (pulsar.frag or theme.frag) and then these, in this order. The renderers (scripts/render-wallpapers.py, scripts/render-theme-wallpapers.py) and the site's sky.ts all read this list. warp.glsl is not shipped: the alternative for slot 7.
